children: Shares of IonQ gained after the company boosted its full-year guidance following its acquisition of chip maker SkyWater Technology.
The stock rose 5.9% to $41.85 in premarket trading on Tuesday. Shares were down 12% year to date at market close.
The quantum computing company said it now expects revenue between $450 million and $460 million in 2026, up from August's guidance range of $280 million to $290 million.
The updated projection factors in the contributions of SkyWater beginning on July 31, when it was acquired by IonQ, through the end of the year.
It also reflects the elimination of estimated intercompany revenues under the pre-existing commercial agreement between IonQ and SkyWater, IonQ said.
IonQ acquired SkyWater for roughly $1.8 billion, adding an exclusively U.S.-based semiconductor foundry that serves industries including quantum computing, defense and aerospace.
